name: Irish moss (sea moss) drink
what_people_do: Boil dried sea moss with milk, spices and sweetener for a thick drink; now sold as a gel supplement.
why_they_say_it_works: Believed to build strength and stamina, treat colds, and boost libido.

documented_by.source: Microbial and heavy metal analyses of commercial sea moss, 2026, J Food Prot, PMID 42710593
documented_by.quote_or_summary: No opened account of Jamaican use (Atlas Obscura page returned 403; search snippets only). A 2026 study of 66 commercial products is the only opened source. UNVERIFIED as documentation.

evidence.finding: Presumptive Salmonella, Bacillus, Staphylococcus; arsenic, cobalt and mercury detected; wide variation.

source.name: Microbial and heavy metal analyses of commercial sea moss, 2026, J Food Prot, PMID 42710593

harm_note: Contamination in commercial products (microbes and metals).
gaps: Entry now exists; no health trial found.
